per_generation_record_schema.prompt_id: string, candidate_prompt_id from Panel V2 (verbatim, e.g. 'SU01')
per_generation_record_schema.prompt_family: string, verbatim from Panel V2 (e.g. 'SUMMARIZATION') -- exact label preserved, no semantic reinterpretation
per_generation_record_schema.prompt_hash: string, copied verbatim from Panel V2 frozen record (provenance link, not recomputed)

per_step_probability_summary.formulas: entropy_from_logits / top2_gap_from_logits, reused verbatim from reports/atlas-kv-compression-v0/execution/kv_capture_lib.py -- not redefined
per_step_probability_summary.epistemic_status: MEASURED (direct softmax of the real per-step logit vector, from generate(..., output_scores=True))

per_generation_record_schema.peak_memory_mb: float, if cheaply available from the runtime environment (e.g. torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated or resource.getrusage) -- NOT_CAPTURED if unavailable at negligible cost
per_generation_record_schema.completion_reason: string, e.g. 'eos_token' | 'max_new_tokens' -- from the actual generation stop reason, not inferred

hidden_state_summary_policy: IF cheaply available without persisting full tensors: allow COMPACT DERIVED summaries only (e.g. final-layer hidden-state norm at each generated step, a single float per step) -- never full per-layer per-step hidden-state vectors. This is a Lane A implementation decision to be finalized at Lane A build time, not frozen with specific fields here; if implemented, it must be documented in the Lane A execution report as an addendum to this schema, not a silent schema change.
explicitly_excluded_from_lane_a: Full-vocabulary logits at every step (only entropy/top1/top2gap summaries)
granularity: RUN x STEP (probability summaries); RUN-level for everything else
family_label_policy: prompt_family is copied verbatim from the frozen Panel V2 record. No new semantic categories are invented.
